title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic street-style fashion portrait of a beautiful young adult East Asian woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, standing in a quiet, narrow Japanese urban backstreet during a softly illuminated afternoon. Capture the scene from a slightly elevated, front-facing camera angle, framing her from the top of her head to approximately her lower legs, with her body occupying the central and lower portions of the vertical composition.

She has a delicate, softly tapered oval face, a small pointed chin, fair porcelain skin with subtle peach-pink undertones, smooth cheeks, a refined narrow nose, and naturally full, softly defined pink lips. Her large, expressive gray-brown almond-shaped eyes feature subtle eyeliner, long curled eyelashes, delicate lower lashes, and softly blended neutral eyeshadow. Her eyebrows are fine and naturally arched. She gazes directly into the camera with a calm, dreamy, slightly melancholic expression, her lips gently closed and her head tilted subtly toward one shoulder.

Her exceptionally long, straight, silky ash-blonde hair has cool beige-gray undertones, falling freely past her chest toward her waist. Thick, wispy, straight-cut bangs frame her forehead just above her eyes, while long face-framing strands cascade naturally over both shoulders. Her hair displays realistic individual strands, soft highlights, and gentle movement.

She has a slender, feminine figure with a noticeably defined waist, naturally full bust, softly rounded hips, and harmonious proportions. She stands with her shoulders angled slightly, her torso gently leaning forward, and both arms positioned behind her back, creating a relaxed, subtly shy pose.

She wears a fitted, charcoal-gray, fine-ribbed knit long-sleeve top with an asymmetrical off-the-shoulder neckline. The soft, draped fabric exposes one shoulder and collarbone while covering the opposite shoulder, closely following her natural silhouette. The top gathers slightly around her waist and ends at her upper hips. She pairs it with loose-fitting, high-waisted ivory-white trousers featuring subtle front pleats, natural folds, and softly flowing fabric. No visible jewelry or additional accessories.

The setting features weathered Japanese residential and commercial buildings, narrow asphalt pavement, overhead electrical wires, concrete utility poles, and a distant white delivery truck. On the left, a rustic wooden display table holds shallow wooden trays, white papers, and small objects, surrounded by numerous potted green plants outside a modest storefront. The street stretches into the background with realistic architectural depth.

Soft, diffused natural daylight gently illuminates her face and hair, producing delicate shadows and authentic skin texture. Use a 35mm full-frame lens, f/2.8 aperture, realistic perspective, subtle background separation, natural depth of field, detailed fabric textures, lifelike anatomy, and cinematic Japanese editorial photography aesthetics. Apply muted neutral color grading, soft gray shadows, warm ivory highlights, understated contrast, and subtle film grain. Ultra-high-resolution photorealism, authentic environmental details, natural proportions, no artificial skin smoothing, no CGI appearance, vertical composition, aspect ratio 3:4.
